economic_hypothesis: A single long-only pattern should not be forced through every market state. In causally known bear states, sharp stock-specific washout followed by active demand or exhausted downside supply can support a short repair. In broad bull or early diffusion states, an underextended stock making its first controlled 20-session pressure break while its PIT industry breadth accelerates can support a slower continuation. Transition states without either mechanism remain cash.
evidence_warning: Both source strategies and all 2014-2026 source outcomes were already observed before this composition was proposed. V28 is a retrospective, multiple-testing-exposed engineering candidate, not pristine validation evidence. The shared-capacity replay is the only previously uncomputed result frozen by this contract.
